summary: Consumer Portfolio Services filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing warehouse revolving credit agreement with Capital One, N.A., and a Class B lender. The facility capacity increased from $390 million to $518 million, with advances up to 95.5% of eligible pledged auto receivables and a funding termination date of October 17, 2027. Loans bear interest at a margin over SOFR and are secured by auto receivables. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, stake, or deal terms apply. Watch borrowing-base utilization and covenant compliance.
